prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Noelia, who usually doubts neighborhood rumors. Noelia trusts the staff who run the municipal pool.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "They’re finally closing the pool, though I’ll believe the "biohazard" excuse when I see it. Mrs. Gable told me she saw the health inspector find mold in the locker room showers back on Tuesday."
text: The pool is being permanently shut down due to a massive, dangerous toxic mold outbreak. The health inspectors have officially condemned the entire facility, so don't even think about going near it.
